translations.web: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.
translations.bsb: The poor you will always have with you, and you can help them whenever you want. But you will not always have Me.
translations.kjv: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.
